items.prompt: Sometimes we need to say whether two fractions are equivalent, and we won’t have a picture to help us. I’ll show you how to say whether two fractions are equivalent, even without a picture to help. Here’s the rule: if a fraction 3/4 is multiplied by one 3/4 × 5/5, then the new fraction 3/4 × 5/5 = 15/20 is equivalent to the original.
items.demo: If a fraction is multiplied by one, then the new fraction is *equivalent to the original*. 3/4 × 5/5 = 15/20
